Description

** 1 hour slot **


Need a 5-a-side football pitch in Southwark, London? Mint Street Gardens boasts a spectacular 5-a-side astroturf football pitch which is available for footballers looking for a one-off game or a regular block booking. It is a 5-a-side pitch that is available to book for one-off training sessions or a season long league.

Customers will be pleased to know that the venue operates a pay-as-you-play booking system. This means sports enthusiasts can just turn up and play depending on availability and book on a pay as you play basis. This method avoids the monthly membership charges and gives you the freedom to play as and when you like.

Looking to set up regular games at Mint Street Gardens? Enquire about making a block booking to ensure you secure the time slot you want to play at every week. Block bookings are perfect for teams who want to be assured that they'll be playing regularly. A block booking is a booking made for a set number of consecutive weeks, on average this is 10 weeks.

The closest tube stop when travelling is Borough. The facility is located a 4 minute walk from here - for more details on how to access the facility please contact the venue.
